summary: Full backend + frontend testing of TaxSathi AI marketing SaaS. All 11 backend tests passed. All major frontend flows working. App loads with dark theme, blueprint grid, Gujarati headline, proper navbar, WhatsApp button, waitlist modal, AI demo with Gemini 2.5 Flash, module analyzer with 5-section output, progress tracker with 7 modules.

issues: Analysis sections rendered as full headings (Product Fit, Pricing Tier, etc.) not as a)/b)/c) — this is actually BETTER UX than plain a)/b)/c) markers. Not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: demo_sessions and analyzer_sessions are in-memory dicts — will lose all session state on server restart. Minor for MVP but worth noting.

server.py line 189: PATCH /progress/{module_id} saves to DB but GET /progress returns hardcoded data — status changes from PATCH endpoint are never reflected in GET response. Functional bug but low priority for current marketing use case.
server.py: No rate limiting on AI endpoints — could be abused.
seed_data_creation: TEST_taxsathi@example.com and uitest_taxsathi@example.com added to waitlist during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows working. Backend: 11/11 tests pass. Frontend: Landing page, Demo (Gemini AI), Module Analyzer, Progress Tracker all verified. Note: PATCH /progress status not reflected in GET (hardcoded data). In-memory sessions for AI chats. App URL: https://taxsaathi-staging.preview.emergentagent.com
rca_of_issues: PATCH /progress/{id} writes to MongoDB but GET /progress returns hardcoded list — the DB writes are never read back. Fix: load overrides from DB in GET /progress or store full module list in DB.
